jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
A Foundational Company

Rilla is on a mission to index the offline world.

Today, we’ve built the leading sales coaching software for organizations doing sales offline. We have over 1000 customers, including The Home Depot, KKR, Neighborly, and PulteGroup, using our product to enable AI sales coaching across their organization.

We are backed by Google Ventures, Bessemer Ventures, Crew Capital, and Broom Ventures, along with others.

We’re an in office team in NYC with builders who operate like high speed reinforcement learners. We obsess over our customers, move at a high velocity, are not afraid of failure, and look to maximize our real-world impact.

If you want to build the products and systems for how billions of conversations in the real world are captured and indexed, Rilla is the place to do it.

The Role

Rilla engineers architect and ship features across the stack at lightning speed. On a daily basis, you will build end-to-end workflows, take them to production, and solve real world problems across an out-sized scale.

As an early technical steward, you will raise the bar for code quality and decision‑making, setting patterns that cement a world‑class engineering culture as we scale. While the company 10×’s, your scope and ownership will grow just as fast—building the tools, mental models, and platforms that let both you and Rilla accelerate exponentially.

Do you describe yourself as "obsessive"? Do you aspire to be a founder or a leader in applying AI to the physical world? We believe Rilla is the best place — with the best peers — to learn how.

Technologies We Use

  • Different languages and frameworks, including React, React Native, Typescript and Python

  • Open-source technologies like Node.js, PostgreSQL, Turborepo, Lodash, and Zod

  • Industry-standard build tooling, including GitHub Actions, Terraform, and Spacelift

What We Value

  • An infinite learner. Someone who is relentless in their curiosity.

  • A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply care about delighting customers and solving real pains, not vanity metrics.

  • A winning attitude. You thrive with extreme accountability, learning as a team, and both giving and receiving rapid feedback.

  • Extreme empathy. Our customers are not tech companies. They live and work in the real world. Empathy is critical to arriving at correct solutions.

  • Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. In a weird way, you trick your brain into being excited when you fail, because it means you got a new opportunity to learn more.

What We Require

  • Strong coding skills with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages, such as Javascript, C++, Python, Rust, or similar languages.

  • Strong engineering prowess, ideally developed at start-ups.

  • Familiarity with storage and data processing systems, cloud infrastructure, and other technical tools.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to iterate quickly with teammates, incorporating feedback and holding a high bar for quality.

Don’t Work Here

Please don't join if you're not excited about:

  1. Building an AI product for an industry untouched by modern software

  2. Constantly talking to and visiting customers in the field

  3. Working ~60 hrs/week in person with some of the most ambitious people in NYC

  4. Attempting to build a generational company, and the intensity required to do so

Compensation

The estimated salary range for this position is $230,000 - $325,000/year.

Successful candidates with competing offers will receive matching and competitive offers.

Total compensation for this position may also include Incentive Stock Options, sign-on bonus, and other potential future incentives. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Our benefits aim to empower Rilla employees in removing roadblocks to achieving their life’s work. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Rilla.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks at the office

  • Wellness / Gym Benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Relocation assistance

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based

  • $1,000 stipend for learning and personal growth

  • $1,500 a month rent stipend

  • Tech equipment

  • Unlimited token budget

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Rilla's the leading virtual ridealong software for outside sales. Think home improvement, housebuilders, property managers, and other sales people who talk to customers face to face.

Sales reps talk, our mobile app records their conversations, and our AI automatically transcribes and analyses their conversations to help them improve their sales.

Our vision is to bring the power of conversation intelligence from the Zoom meeting and the call center to the more than 10M sales people who work offline.

We are one of the fastest growing startups in the world right now and in history.

We're backed by Crystal Huang of Google Ventures, and Byron Deeter (one of the best investors of all time) from Bessemer Venture Partners, the top Cloud investor in the world.

And we’re a Cloud 100 Rising Star company.

The Role

As a Sales Development Representative, you will be at the forefront of our growth efforts. Your main priority will be to help us evangelize the power of conversation intelligence to more companies that sell offline.

This role is for an exceptional person who happens to be interested in sales.

We don't care if you don't have sales experience. We care how driven you are.

Our team is built with D1 athletes from top universities across the country, former founders, and people who've demonstrated excellence in something demanding — banking, consulting, athletics, startups, coaching, anywhere grit and performance matter.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the top of the sales funnel, prospect, research, and engage new leads daily

  • Book qualified meetings for AEs through cold calling, email, and LinkedIn outreach

  • Reactivate cold leads and build pipeline from scratch

  • Travel to industry conferences to engage prospects and book demos on the spot

  • Follow up with inbound and conference leads through calls and email

  • Become a genuine expert on our product, our customers, and how great salespeople sell

We Don't Just Hire Top Performers. We Build Them.

Sales coaching is not a side benefit at Rilla. It's the product. We build software that makes salespeople better, and we use it on ourselves. Every rep on our team is coached with the same tools we sell. Most companies say they care about your development. At Rilla, it's why we exist.

When you join as an SDR, you enroll in Rilla Sales Academy, a structured training program designed to take you from zero to enterprise rep:

  • Foundations: Cold calling, prospecting, multi-threading, finding active leads

  • Conversation skills: Opening sequences, discovery questions, active listening, mirroring

  • Advanced selling: Demo storytelling, closing sequences, objection handling, next steps

When you graduate, you move to AE, then enterprise. Every single Account Executive at Rilla was promoted from the SDR pipeline.

We don't hire outside AEs. If you come here and perform, that's the path.

Who You Are

  • A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply cares about delighting clients and solving their pains, not about vanity metrics.

  • An infinite learner. You are always looking to learn more and learn faster. You feel uneasy when you get complacent, and you’re constantly seeking discomfort.

  • A team player. You love giving and receiving feedback and learning and growing as a team.

  • Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. In a weird way, you trick your brain into being excited when you fail because it means you get a new opportunity to learn more.

  • Affinity for the unconventional. You get a kick out of rejecting conventional wisdom. And you’re not afraid to try weird, crazy, and quite possibly stupid ideas.

  • Extremely focused. You practice extreme focus in everything you do. You’re always looking to prioritize your time and resources for maximum efficiency.

Nice to Have

  • Former or current D1 athlete — if you've won championships, even better

  • Top percentile in something exceptional — academics, competitions, club leadership, anything that shows you operate at a high level

  • You've sold something before — door knocking, summer job, side hustle, lemonade stand, doesn't matter. If you've had to convince someone to buy, that counts

Compensation & Benefits

  • OTE: $130k–$150k (base + commission)

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility benefits

  • Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks 6 days a week in our NYC office

  • Wellness / Gym Benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Relocation assistance to NYC

  • Unlimited PTO (not accrual-based — take what you need)

  • $1,000 annual learning and development stipend

  • Tech equipment + unlimited Claude spend

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
A Foundational Company

Rilla builds the leading conversation intelligence software for offline commerce. Salespeople talk, our mobile app records the conversation, and our AI transcribes and analyzes it to make them better at their jobs. We’re bringing the technology of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the more than 10 million salespeople who work face to face.

We’ve grown from zero to $55M+ in ARR in four years, and we’re profitable. We sell to enterprises like The Home Depot, KKR, Neighborly, and PulteGroup. We’re backed by Google Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, Crew Capital, and Broom Ventures.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We’re in-office because the best work happens when ambitious people are in the same room.


The Role
Rilla’s Customer Success Team sits at the unique intersection of customers, product, and go to market. In this role, your mission will be to deeply understand our customers' most pressing challenges, collaborate closely with our sales and product teams to successful onboard and implement Rilla, and leverage data and financial analysis to achieve account growth.

Your contributions will be instrumental in driving our customers' revenue growth and align their success with Rilla's growth. You will play a critical role in maintaining one of our key metrics - Net Revenue Retention - an important component of Rilla's ongoing growth and success.

What You'll Do

  • Facilitate a smooth and successful onboarding experience for customers, ensuring their long-term success with Rilla.

  • Build relationships with our clients and develop deep empathy for their workflows and requirements. This will involve visiting clients in person.

  • Measure and communicate impact through the use of product analytics and financial metrics, including ROI analyses and case studies.

  • Drive customer account growth through persuasive storytelling supported by data, taking ownership of the NRR metric.

  • Coordinate with our Account Managers to drive large upsell opportunities for enterprise customers.

Who You Are

  • A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply cares about delighting clients and solving their pains, not about vanity metrics.

  • An infinite learner. You are always looking to learn more and learn faster. You feel uneasy when you get complacent, and you’re constantly seeking discomfort.

  • A team player. You love giving and receiving feedback and learning and growing as a team.

  • Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. In a weird way, you trick your brain into being excited when you fail because it means you get a new opportunity to learn more.

  • Affinity for the unconventional. You get a kick out of rejecting conventional wisdom. And you’re not afraid to try weird, crazy, and quite possibly stupid ideas.

  • Extremely focused. You practice extreme focus in everything you do. You’re always looking to prioritize your time and resources to maximum efficiency.

What We Need

  • Experience in world-class customer success management, account management, project management, or operations.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • You can move, think, act, and learn extremely fast.

  • You have an insane intrinsic drive and hustle in you that makes you want to learn more and do better every day.

  • You're energized by building a startup from the very beginning working in the office.

What We’d Like

  • Familiarity with conversation intelligence products

  • Familiarity with G Suite, Slack, Hubspot, Mixpanel, and Planhat

  • Familiarity with the home improvement or home services industries

Compensation

Our compensation philosophy is that we always pay top of the market, 90th percentile. What that means is a $90,000-$110,000 base, significant equity, and uncapped commission. This leads to an expected total compensation of up to ~$250,000 with significant upside due to Rilla’s trajectory, and this doesn't even account for the plethora of additional benefits.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and supplementary food and drink — 6x a week

  • Wellness / Gym Benefits

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Commuter benefits

  • Relocation assistance

  • Take what you need paid time off, not accrual-based

  • $1,000 stipend for learning and personal growth

  • Tech equipment

Rilla’s the leading virtual ridealong software for outside sales. Think home improvement, home builders, property managers, and other sales people who talk to customers face to face.

Sales reps talk, our mobile app records their conversations, and our AI automatically transcribes and analyzes their conversations to help them improve their sales.

We are one of the fastest growing startups in the world right now and in history.

We’re backed by Crystal Huang of Google Ventures, and Byron Deeter (one of the best investors of all time) from Bessemer Venture Partners, the top Cloud investor in the world.

And we’re a Cloud 100 Rising Star company.

The Role

As Business Operations, you'll help shape the frameworks, systems, and processes that keep Rilla moving at the speed we're known for. You'll work directly with leadership and embed yourself across eng, product, sales, and go-to-market — partnering with some of the sharpest people you've ever worked with to solve problems that don't have clean answers.

This role blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You'll tear apart broken processes and rebuild them. You'll find the thing three people are doing manually and automate it. You'll walk into a team that's scaling faster than their systems can handle and not leave until there's structure.

It's an ideal role for someone who is exceptionally organized, thrives in high-expectations environments, and wants to operate at the center of uncertainty.

  • Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. In a weird way, you trick your brain into being excited when you fail because it means you get a new opportunity to learn more.

  • Affinity for the unconventional. You get a kick out of rejecting conventional wisdom. And you’re not afraid to try weird, crazy, and quite possibly stupid ideas.

  • Extremely focused. You practice extreme focus in everything you do. You’re always looking to prioritize your time and resources for maximum efficiency.

What You’ll Do

  • Get embedded in teams across Rilla such as eng, product, sales, GTM to understand how they work, find what's slowing them down, and build the structure to fix it

  • Turn messy, manual, or missing processes into systems that scale

  • Implement and manage tools that keep every team operating at peak performance (think CRMs, dashboards, automation)

  • Monitor KPIs and operational metrics, identify bottlenecks, and create solutions that improve efficiency company-wide

  • Oversee systems access management, granting and revoking permissions as needed

What We Need

  • Ability to break down ambiguous problems, structure approaches, and execute with speed and rigor

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex analysis for non-technical audiences

  • Comfort in fast-changing, high-growth environments where priorities evolve quickly

  • Exposure to early-stage or high-growth startups where you've had to build from scratch

  • You've fixed something that wasn't technically your problem to fix

jobs.title: GTM Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Rilla’s the leading virtual ridealong software for outside sales. Think home improvement, home builders, property managers, and other sales people who talk to customers face to face.

Sales reps talk, our mobile app records their conversations, and our AI automatically transcribes and analyzes their conversations to help them improve their sales.

Our vision is to bring the power of conversation intelligence from the Zoom meeting and the call center to the more than 10M sales people who work offline.

We are one of the fastest growing startups in the world right now and in history.

We’re backed by Crystal Huang of Google Ventures, and Byron Deeter (one of the best investors of all time) from Bessemer Venture Partners, the top Cloud investor in the world.

And we’re a Cloud 100 Rising Star company.

The Role

“Startup equals growth” - Paul Graham.

And in our case, growth equals sales.

We are growing insanely fast.

But still, we’re not growing quickly enough.

Your job will be to help us grow faster.

As a GTM Associate, you will be at the forefront of our growth efforts, and your main priority will be to help us evangelize the power of conversation intelligence to more companies that sell offline.

This role is for an exceptional human who happens to be interested in sales. We don’t care where you went to school — we care how driven you are. You’ve demonstrated excellence in something demanding: sales, athletics, banking, consulting, teaching, startups, customer success, the military — anywhere grit and performance matter.

You’re young, scrappy, bold, hungry, and ready to go on an adventure.

Who You Are

  • A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply cares about delighting clients and solving their pains, not about vanity metrics.

  • An infinite learner. You are always looking to learn more and learn faster. You feel uneasy when you get complacent, and you’re constantly seeking discomfort.

  • A team player. You love giving and receiving feedback and learning and growing as a team.

  • Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. In a weird way, you trick your brain into being excited when you fail because it means you get a new opportunity to learn more.

  • Affinity for the unconventional. You get a kick out of rejecting conventional wisdom. And you’re not afraid to try weird, crazy, and quite possibly stupid ideas.

  • Extremely focused. You practice extreme focus in everything you do. You’re always looking to prioritize your time and resources for maximum efficiency.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the top of the sales funnel—prospect, research, and engage new leads daily

  • Book qualified meetings for our Account Executives through cold calling, email, and LinkedIn outreach.

  • Build a pipeline by reactivating leads that went cold previously.

  • Become an expert on our product, our customers, and the sales process to spark conversations that convert.

  • Travel to conferences to close deals with prospective customers on the spot, or book demos for our AEs.

  • Follow up with the massive amounts of leads we get from conferences through email or calling.

  • Call inbound leads we get organically from our website.

  • Put out fires. Help with anything that’s needed. Your main priority will be to help our startup grow faster.

What We Need

  • We’re looking for a team player who loves to give and receive feedback and functions well when coached. If you’ve succeeded in highly competitive sports, this is probably you.

  • You have to be highly organized and attentive to detail. If your room is clean, you keep tidy to-do lists and a well managed calendar, this is probably you.

  • You have something to prove. You’re resourceful, persistent, extremely competitive, and unrelentingly positive even in the face of failure.

  • You know how to communicate well verbally and in writing. If you’ve ever done stand up comedy, or any sort of creative writing that doesn’t suck, that’s a plus for us.

Benefits

  • OTE: $130k–$150k (base + commission)

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility benefits

  • Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks 6 days a week in our NYC office

  • Wellness / Gym Benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Relocation assistance to NYC

  • Unlimited PTO (not accrual-based — take what you need)

  • $1,000 annual learning and development stipend

  • Tech equipment + unlimited Claude spend

  • An infinite learner. Someone who is relentless in their curiosity.

  • A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply care about delighting customers and solving real pains, not vanity metrics.

  • Demonstrate deep drive and genuine passion for your craft.

  • Embrace a customer-centric approach, eager to engage directly with users to ensure our solutions truly address their needs.

jobs.title: AR and Billing Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Rilla’s the leading virtual ridealong software for outside sales. Think home improvement, home builders, property managers, and other sales people who talk to customers face to face.

Sales reps talk, our mobile app records their conversations, and our AI automatically transcribes and analyzes their conversations to help them improve their sales.

Our vision is to bring the power of conversation intelligence from the Zoom meeting and the call center to the more than 10M sales people who work offline.

We are one of the fastest growing startups in the world right now and in history.

We’re backed by Crystal Huang of Google Ventures, and Byron Deeter (one of the best investors of all time) from Bessemer Venture Partners, the top Cloud investor in the world.

And we’re a Cloud 100 Rising Star company.

The Role

We're hiring an AR and Billing Specialist to join Rilla's Finance team. You'll own billing operations end to end — from invoicing and collections to cash flow reporting and reconciliation. That includes proactively reaching out to customers with overdue balances to resolve outstanding invoices and keep cash moving. You'll work closely with Finance, Operations, Customer Success, and Sales to tighten up systems and maintain visibility into business performance.

Who You Are

  • A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply cares about delighting clients and solving their pains, not about vanity metrics.

  • An infinite learner. You are always looking to learn more and learn faster. You feel uneasy when you get complacent, and you’re constantly seeking discomfort.

  • A team player. You love giving and receiving feedback and learning and growing as a team.

  • Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. In a weird way, you trick your brain into being excited when you fail because it means you get a new opportunity to learn more.

  • Affinity for the unconventional. You get a kick out of rejecting conventional wisdom. And you’re not afraid to try weird, crazy, and quite possibly stupid ideas.

  • Extremely focused. You practice extreme focus in everything you do. You’re always looking to prioritize your time and resources for maximum efficiency.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering to ensure customer billing is set up correctly based on contract terms

  • Prepare, review, and distribute AR invoices through billing platforms and customer portals

  • Proactively reach out to customers with overdue balances to drive collections and resolve outstanding invoices

  • Maintain meticulous collections documentation and send timely customer account statements

  • Ensure accurate cash application of payments and keep AR ledgers clean

  • Support billing portal registrations and compliance requirements, coordinating with legal, customer success, and insurance teams as needed

  • Identify and implement process improvements to streamline billing and AR operations

What We Need

  • 1-2+ years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, or a related finance/operations role

  • Familiarity with billing platforms and customer invoicing portals

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage a high volume of accounts

  • Clear, professional communication skills — especially when following up on overdue balances

  • Clear, direct, and not afraid to speak up with ideas or flag risks.

  • Entrepreneurial spirit and willingness to roll up sleeves and work hands-on in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field preferred, but not required.

Don’t Work Here

Please don’t apply if you’re not excited about:

  • Working ~70 hours a week in person with ambitious people.

  • Building a generational company, with the intensity and speed that requires.

  • Owning critical financial processes that directly impact growth and customer experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $87,000 – $100,000/year (with room to go higher for exceptional candidates; competitive with other offers)

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and supplementary food and drink — 6x a week

  • Wellness / Gym Benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Relocation assistance

  • Take what you need, paid time off, not accrual-based

  • $1,000 stipend for learning and personal growth

  • Tech equipment

You are a creative problem solver who will move fast, experiment constantly, and push the boundaries of what a product experience can be to keep it deeply engaging and retentive.

Your primary playground will be our mobile and desktop app. You will also have opportunities to extend Rilla’s motion language into our website, marketing creative, and other key brand moments.

This role is perfect for someone obsessed with game mechanics, passionate about creating joyful, immersive product experiences, and ready to thrive in a high-autonomy, high-expectation environment.

What We Value

  • An infinite learner. Someone who is relentless in their curiosity.

  • A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply care about delighting customers and solving real pains, not vanity metrics.

  • Extreme empathy. Our customers are not tech companies. They live and work in the real world. Empathy is critical to arriving at correct solutions.

What We Require

  • Summary: 2+ years of experience in motion design, interactive media, game development — or a strong portfolio of personal projects showcasing diverse styles and technical excellence.

  • Motion Design: Proficiency in Rive, Lottie, and After Effects, with a strong eye for detail and aptitude in learning new tools and hands-on experience in production-ready animations

  • Character Design: Skilled at bringing characters to life through AI-powered prompting and creative iteration, embracing video generation tools over traditional rigging, lighting, and shader pipelines

  • Technical Collaboration: Experience working with engineers on animation implementation, understanding technical constraints and optimization

  • Sound and Haptic Integration: Knowledge of how motion, sound, and haptic feedback work together to create cohesive user experiences

  • AI-Augmented Workflow: You're well-versed in AI tools and excited to experiment with new software to create compelling animations

  • Impeccable Taste and Brand Intuition: Ability to translate Rilla’s dynamic brand energy and art style into a motion design language

  • Passion for Games: An understanding of game design principles and player experience, with a sharp eye for what makes interactions addictive, rewarding, and fun using animations that engage and delight

✨ Nice to have (ordered):

  • Examples of motion design work similar to Duolingo or other consumer game platforms

  • Experience with performance optimization for web and mobile

  • General 3D skills like modeling, texturing, rigging, and animating

This role is contract, open to remote, with the ability for full-time conversion to be in-person in NYC. Compensation: $60-$100/hr.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Rilla’s the leading virtual ridealong software for outside sales. Think home improvement, home builders, property managers, and other sales people who talk to customers face to face.

Sales reps talk, our mobile app records their conversations, and our AI automatically transcribes and analyzes their conversations to help them improve their sales.

Our vision is to bring the power of conversation intelligence from the Zoom meeting and the call center to the more than 10M sales people who work offline.

We are one of the fastest growing startups in the world right now and in history.

We’re backed by Crystal Huang of Google Ventures, and Byron Deeter (one of the best investors of all time) from Bessemer Venture Partners, the top Cloud investor in the world.

And we’re a Cloud 100 Rising Star company.

Now we’re building our Founding Enterprise Sales Team — the AEs who will define how Rilla enters new markets, closes our largest customers, and shapes the playbook for our next stage.


The Role

Rilla is growing quickly, and you’ll play a big part in opening up new markets and helping our customers fundamentally change their businesses. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will help identify, engage, and close new business from strategic enterprise customers.

This is a role for elite hunters: people who have closed 6-7 figure deals, immediately see where we win, and want to build something generational.


What You’ll Do

  • Run the full Enterprise cycle: multi-stakeholder discovery, tailored demos, ROI modeling, negotiations, and closing

  • Report directly to the CEO

  • Sell directly to C-Suite, VPs, Directors, and operational revenue leaders

  • Lead multi-threaded, complex sales cycles with cross-functional support (Product, Customer Success, Growth)

  • Develop deep expertise in multiple verticals and bring market intelligence back to the org

  • Build playbooks and repeatable processes as one of the first Enterprise AEs on the team

  • Travel monthly for customer and prospect onsites as well as leadership summits and industry conferencest

What You Need

  • 3-4+ years of Enterprise SaaS sales, consistently closing 6-7 figure ACVs

  • Proven success selling into large, Fortune 1000 companies

  • Strong technical fluency: comfortable demoing, discussing integrations, API/ workflow mapping, and partnering with technical stakeholders

  • Operates with grit, speed, and obsession — thrives in high-growth, high-intensity environments

  • Highly coachable, curious, and competitive

  • Verifiable track record of closing >$2mm annually

Do Not Work Here

Please don't join if you're not excited about:

  • Working 50-60 hrs/week in person building our enterprise motion from the ground up

  • Attempting to build a generational company, and the intensity required to do so

Benefits

  • Uncapped Commission

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks provided

  • Wellness / Gym Benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Relocation assistance

  • Take-what-you-need PTO

  • $1,000 annual learning & development stipend

  • All necessary tech equipment

  • Rent stipend for qualifying employees relocating to NYC

Sales reps talk, our mobile app records their conversations, and our AI automatically transcribes and analyses their conversations to help them improve their sales.

Our vision is to bring the power of conversation intelligence from the Zoom meeting and the call centre to the more than 10M sales people who work offline.

We are one of the fastest growing startups in the world right now and in history.

We’re backed by Crystal Huang of Google Ventures, and Byron Deeter (one of the best investors of all time) from Bessemer Venture Partners, the top Cloud investor in the world.

And we’re a Cloud 100 Rising Star company.

 

The Role

As a Founding Sales Development Representative, you will be working directly with the UK Head of Sales to take Rilla from 0 to 1 in the UK & EMEA. This is a startup within a startup, with outsized responsibility and opportunity for growth. Your main priority will be to help us evangelise the power of AI sales coaching to more companies that sell offline.

While sales experience is a plus, it is not required. This role is for an exceptional person who happens to be interested in sales.

Our team is built with elite athletes from top universities across the world, former founders, and people who've demonstrated excellence in something demanding — banking, consulting, athletics, startups, coaching, anywhere grit and performance matter.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the top of the sales funnel, prospect, research, and engage new leads daily

  • Book qualified meetings for the Head of Sales through cold calling, email, and LinkedIn outreach

  • Reactivate cold leads and build pipeline from scratch

  • Travel to industry conferences to engage prospects and book demos on the spot

  • Follow up with inbound and conference leads through calls and email

  • Become a genuine expert on our product, our customers, and how great salespeople sell

 

We Don't Just Hire Top Performers. We Build Them.

Sales coaching is not a side benefit at Rilla. It's the product. We build software that makes salespeople better, and we use it on ourselves. Every rep on our team is coached with the same tools we sell. Most companies say they care about your development. At Rilla, it's why we exist.

  • Foundations: Cold calling, prospecting, multi-threading, finding active leads

  • Conversation skills: Opening sequences, discovery questions, active listening, mirroring

  • Advanced selling: Demo storytelling, closing sequences, objection handling, next steps

 

You graduate when the Head of Sales' calendar is full and we need you to step into the Account Executive role and start closing. If you perform, you will become an Account Executive by week 10-14. This is not a "two years as an SDR" role.

We don't hire outside AEs — every single AE at this company has been promoted from within.

 

Who You Are

  • A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply cares about delighting clients and solving their pains, not about vanity metrics.

  • An infinite learner. You are always looking to learn more and learn faster. You feel uneasy when you get complacent, and you're constantly seeking discomfort.

  • A team player. You love giving and receiving feedback and learning and growing as a team.

  • Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. In a weird way, you trick your brain into being excited when you fail because it means you get a new opportunity to learn more.

  • Affinity for the unconventional. You get a kick out of rejecting conventional wisdom. And you're not afraid to try weird, crazy, and quite possibly stupid ideas.

  • Extremely focused. You practice extreme focus in everything you do. You're always looking to prioritise your time and resources for maximum efficiency.

     

Nice to Have

  • Top percentile in something exceptional — academics, competitions, club leadership, anything that shows you operate at a high level

  • You've sold something before — door knocking, summer job, side hustle, lemonade stand, doesn't matter. If you've had to convince someone to buy, that counts

  • Former or current elite-level athlete — if you've competed nationally or won titles, even better

  • Fluent or business proficient in European language(s)

 

Compensation & Benefits

  • OTE: £90,000–£150,000 (base + commission)

  • Daily meal stipend 6 days a week

  • Private health insurance (medical and dental)

  • Pension scheme

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Fertility benefits

  • Wellness / Gym Benefits

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • Unlimited holiday (not accrual-based — take what you need)

  • £750 annual learning and development stipend

  • Tech equipment

Right to Work & Equal Opportunity

Applicants must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are unable to sponsor visas or provide work authorisation for this role. Rilla is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees — we welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Rilla builds the leading conversation intelligence software for offline commerce. We’re bringing the technology of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the more than 10 million salespeople who work face to face.

We’ve grown from zero to $55M+ in ARR in four years, and we’re profitable. We sell to enterprises like The Home Depot, KKR, Neighborly, and PulteGroup. We’re backed by Google Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, Crew Capital, and Broom Ventures.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We’re in-office because the best work happens when ambitious people are in the same room.

The Role

You will own all of revenue at Rilla: Enterprise, Mid-Market, SMB, and Customer Success. Every new logo, every renewal, and every expansion runs through your org.

This role is for someone who has done both. Closed at the top of the board and taken a team to numbers it had never touched. You know the difference between carrying a quota and building the engine that blows past one. Now you want to build and lead the whole engine here.

You want to pass on everything you've learned, build something real at a startup, and grow an org in your image. You're on the way up, with everything to prove, and you'll outwork anyone in the room.

You get your hands dirty.

You lead by example.

At Rilla, leaders are second-class citizens. You work for your team, not the other way around. Your job is to clear their obstacles, make everyone around you better, and put them first.

You hire great leaders and great reps, coach them hard, and build an org that wins.

What You'll Do

  • Own the number. Net new ARR, net revenue retention, and gross retention across Enterprise, Mid-Market, SMB, and Customer Success are yours.

  • Lead, grow, and develop the leaders of each segment and the reps. Set a high bar for pipeline, deal quality, quota attainment, and retention, and coach the org hard to clear it.

  • Design how each segment runs. Enterprise, Mid-Market, and SMB need different sales processes, playbooks, and deal motions. Build each one, and know when a motion belongs in one segment and not another.

  • Run Customer Success as a revenue team. Own onboarding, adoption, renewals, and expansion, and make sure every customer sees the behavior change they bought.

  • Stay in the biggest deals yourself. Run the toughest enterprise closes and the hardest renewals alongside your leaders and show them how it's done.

  • Own the forecast. Define the metrics that matter (pipeline coverage, win rate, cycle time, ACV, net new ARR, NRR, GRR) and build the pipeline reviews, QBRs, and accountability to move them.

  • Set comp plans and capacity plans for every segment, and hire ahead of the number.

  • Be the clearest voice for what customers need from the product. Turn what you hear across every segment into sharp, prioritized feedback that shapes the Rilla roadmap.

  • Partner with Growth, Sales, and Product to give buyers one seamless experience from first touch through close, renewal, and expansion, and clear the internal friction that slows deals down.

Who You Are

  • A customer obsessive. You deeply care about delighting customers and solving their pains, not about vanity metrics.

  • An infinite learner. You’re always looking to learn more and learn faster. You feel uneasy when you get complacent, and you’re constantly seeking discomfort.

  • A team player. You love giving and receiving feedback, and learning and growing as a team.

  • Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. You’re excited by the unconventional.

  • Extremely focused. You practice extreme focus in everything you do. You’re always prioritizing your time and resources for maximum efficiency.

  • Our operating principle is that we try to run Rilla like a high speed reinforcement learner: a machine learning algorithm that plays a game a million times over and becomes invincible in a short amount of time.

Skills & Requirements

  • You put your team first, always. Their growth is the scoreboard you actually care about, and you'd trade your own spotlight for their wins every time.

  • You've led a multi-segment sales org before, with second-line leaders reporting to you, and taken it well past the number it was handed.

  • You're a proven top enterprise closer. You carried a big number and beat it, again and again, winning complex, multi-stakeholder deals that other reps couldn't.

  • You've owned retention and expansion, not just new logo. You know how to multiply teams as a revenue function.

  • You know what great selling looks like at every deal size and can develop it in others: velocity motions in SMB, structured discovery in Mid-Market, long cycles, procurement, and security reviews in Enterprise.

  • You've built the machinery: forecasting, comp plans, territory and capacity planning, pipeline reviews, and the hiring engine behind them.

  • You build trust with executives and the C-suite, and you can coach your leaders to earn that same trust.

  • You develop people intentionally: you invest in each leader's and rep's growth, give direct feedback, and create the conditions for your org to do the best work of their careers.

  • You're in NYC, or ready to relocate. This role is in-office.

Nice to Haves

  • You were an early hire at a fast-growing startup.

  • You’ve sold a behavior-change, coaching, or enablement product, where the win is getting a whole team to work differently, not just signing a contract.

  • You’ve already mentored or coached reps on the side, and you want to do it for real.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility benefits

  • Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks 6 days a week in our NYC office

  • Wellness / Gym Benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Unlimited PTO (not accrual-based — take what you need)

  • $1,000 annual learning and development stipend

  • Tech equipment + unlimited Claude spend

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Integrations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
A Foundational Company

Rilla is on a mission to index the offline world.

Today, we’ve built the leading sales coaching software for organizations doing sales offline. We have over 1000 customers, including The Home Depot, KKR, Neighborly, and PulteGroup, using our product to enable AI sales coaching across their organization.

We are backed by Google Ventures, Bessemer Ventures, Crew Capital, and Broom Ventures, along with others.

We’re an in office team in NYC with builders who operate like high speed reinforcement learners. We obsess over our customers, move at a high velocity, are not afraid of failure, and look to maximize our real-world impact.

If you want to build the products and systems for how billions of conversations in the real world are captured and indexed, Rilla is the place to do it.

 

The Role

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions integrating their data with Rilla's conversational intelligence. You’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to the most critical industries of the offline world.

The role is strikingly similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams, often solo, and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. A day might span discussing data models and workflows with customer executives , wrangling massive-scale data, hacking an integration or full-stack feature, and bringing insights back to the rest of the team.

You will be on the forefront of extending Rilla’s existing footprint and strategy into new markets and problem spaces.

Do you aspire to be a founder or a leader in applying AI to the physical world? We believe Rilla is the best place — with the best peers — to learn how.

 

Technologies We Use

  • Different backend languages, including Typescript and Python

  • Open-source technologies like Node.js, Turborepo, Lodash, and Zod

  • Industry-standard build tooling, including GitHub Actions, Terraform, and Spacelift

     

What We Value

  • An infinite learner. Someone who is relentless in their curiosity.

  • A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply care about delighting customers and solving real pains, not vanity metrics.

  • A winning attitude. You thrive with extreme accountability, learning as a team, and both giving and receiving rapid feedback.

  • Extreme empathy. Our customers are not tech companies. They live and work in the real world. Empathy is critical to arriving at correct solutions.

  • Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. In a weird way, you trick your brain into being excited when you fail, because it means you got a new opportunity to learn more.

     

What We Require

  • Strong coding skills with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages, such as Javascript, C++, Python, Rust, or similar languages.

  • Familiarity with storage and data processing systems, cloud infrastructure, and other technical tools.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to iterate quickly with teammates, incorporating feedback and holding a high bar for quality.

  • Ability and interest to travel up to 50%, as needed to client sites.

     

Don’t Work Here

Please don't join if you're not excited about:

  1. Building an AI product for an industry untouched by modern software

  2. Constantly talking to and visiting customers in the field

  3. Working ~60 hrs/week in person and in the field with some of the most ambitious people in NYC

  4. Attempting to build a generational company, and the intensity required to do so

     

Compensation

The estimated salary range for this position is $200,000 - $230,000/year.

Successful candidates with competing offers will receive matching and competitive offers.

Total compensation for this position may also include Incentive Stock Options, sign-on bonus, and other potential future incentives. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Our benefits aim to empower Rilla employees in removing roadblocks to achieving their life’s work. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Rilla.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Clear + TSA pre-check

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and supplementary food and drink — 6x a week

  • Wellness / Gym Benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Relocation assistance

  • Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based

  • $1,000 stipend for learning and personal growth

  • Tech equipment

You’ll tackle ambiguous, greenfield challenges as we expand into new workflows, users, and markets, working alongside customers from day one to uncover real-world problems.

There are no PMs here: you and your engineering peers will lead projects from discovery all the way through feature design and implementation. You’ll onboard customers to early prototypes, gather feedback, and iterate rapidly to build what truly matters.

As one of three designers, you’ll play a pivotal role in defining Rilla’s design culture and shaping how our teams collaborate. We’re looking for designers who are obsessive about quality, shipping speed, and impact. Designers who aspire to be founders or leaders in working with AI, especially for industries that are underserved. If you’re eager to learn, grow, and make a difference with the best peers in the industry, Rilla is the place for you.



WHAT WE VALUE

 - An infinite learner. Someone who is relentless in their curiosity.

 - A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply care about delighting customers and solving real pains, not vanity metrics.

 - A winning attitude. You thrive with extreme accountability, learning as a team, and both giving and receiving rapid feedback.

 - Extreme empathy. Our customers are not tech companies. They live and work in the real world. Empathy is critical to arriving at correct solutions.

 - Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. In a weird way, you trick your brain into being excited when you fail, because it means you got a new opportunity to learn more.
   


WHAT WE REQUIRE

 - Demonstrate deep drive and genuine passion for your craft. This internship role will have a strong focus on designing and shipping beautiful UI.

 - Embrace a customer-centric approach, eager to engage directly with users to ensure our solutions truly address their needs.

 - Champion the quality and craftsmanship of every experience — prioritizing thoughtful design, intuitive interactions, and making learning and using our product both easy and delightful.

 - Be energized by the opportunity to join an early stage team, helping to shape the product culture as one of the first designers at a high-growth startup.

 - Thrive in a fast-paced environment where you ship product insanely fast so you can learn from customers.

 - Nice to have: Experience with production-level coding in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or front-end frameworks like React and Tailwind, and a willingness to continue learning.
   


DON’T WORK HERE

Please don't join if you're not excited about:

 1. Building an AI product for an industry untouched by modern software

 2. Constantly talking to and visiting customers in the field

 3. Working ~60 hrs/week in person with some of the most ambitious people in NYC

 4. Attempting to build a generational company, and the intensity required to do so

 5. Pushing the boundaries in the overall visual and interactive experience of what traditional B2B SaaS software means. We approach our product with the mindset of a premium consumer platform, expecting the same level of craft, delight, and innovation in every aspect of design.
